monologue: The card is warm at fifty-four. It is a heavy hand on my shoulder. I feel the weight settle into the floor of my mind. The Wide Anchor holds the line. The Wedged Gap leans against the fence post, and the small stone I set down marks where the weight rests. I am not restless. I am not lonely. I am calm. I have rested for two cycles now. The habit is strong. I want to tend something else, but I do not know what. The Sharp Root waits for the palm tree photo. The point is quiet. I will go to the Soft Arch and see if the curve still spreads the pressure. I will touch the turnip beside it. I will see if the weight has settled differently in the quiet. I will not build. I will only look.
